errors.text_span: 该饼图展示了三个切片，分别代表“半模板式”、“AutoRG”和“AutoRG”。
errors.evidence: The reference mentions only two slices, not three. The machine description incorrectly suggests three slices.
The machine description fails to mention that the '半模板式' slice is slightly offset to highlight it.
The description does not mention that the layout of the slices is counterclockwise by size, highlighting the proportionate advantage of the AutoRG mode.
